name: AI Dog Repeller
postCreateCommand: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends libgl1 libglib2.0-0 && pip install torch torchvision --index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cpu && pip install -r requirements-dev.txt && pip install --no-deps -e .
postAttachCommand: echo 'Try it:  python -m dog_repeller --demo --no-window   then open the Ports tab -> 8000'
